design_concept: Executive Editorial Brutalism. A mature, high-contrast, text-forward design blending Swiss grid discipline with organic spacing. Uses a 'Slate & Teal' palette to convey authority and modern sophistication for an executive portfolio.

typography.font_strategy: The 'Old Money Tech' Pairing (Classic Serif Head + Sterile Mono/Clean Sans Body)

scale.h2_chapter: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl leading-tight tracking-tight font-normal

layout_and_spacing.grid_system: The 'Tetris' Grid (Asymmetrical Bento/Editorial Grid). Leave empty cells for negative space.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Solid flat backgrounds with 1px delicate borders (`border-border`). No heavy drop shadows. Rely on typography and negative space for structure.
visual_enhancers.textures: Include a subtle noise/grain overlay fixed on the body to break digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.border_radius: Rounded-none or ultra-sharp (max 2px) to maintain editorial rigidness.

motion.scrolling: MUST use 'lenis' for momentum smooth scrolling.
motion.hero_reveal: Masked line-by-line reveal using framer-motion. Wrap each line of text in an `overflow-hidden` div, and animate the inner text from `y: '100%'` to `y: 0` with a slow ease (e.g., `[0.76, 0, 0.24, 1]`).
motion.scroll_reveals: Staggered fade-up (`y: 30`, `opacity: 0` -> `y: 0`, `opacity: 1`) on scroll for Experience and Project items.
motion.parallax: Subtle framer-motion `useScroll` + `useTransform` on the hero portrait or abstract image (moving slightly vertically relative to scroll).

sections_direction.navigation: Sticky, Glassmorphism (`backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#F4F4F0]/90`), 1px bottom border. Include Logo/Name, anchor links, and a primary 'Get in Touch' button. Do NOT make it fully transparent.

hero.layout: Asymmetrical Grid. Left column: Kinetic Typography. Right column/Background: Subtle Parallax Image.
hero.content: Name ('Peterson Pereira'), Headline ('Global Head of Talent Acquisition'), and a 1-line Tagline [PLACEHOLDER: Tagline].

sections_direction.marquee: Slow editorial ribbon using 'react-fast-marquee'. Pale background (`#EAEAE5`), dark serif text, massive gaps. Text: 'TALENT ACQUISITION • LEADERSHIP • CULTURE • [PLACEHOLDER: Core Value]'.

about_manifesto.layout: Numbered chapters (e.g., '01 / The Philosophy'). Asymmetrical two-column grid where chapter number is massive and content is compact.
about_manifesto.content: 2-3 sentences summarising background. Use `[PLACEHOLDER: About Summary]`.

experience_timeline.layout: Vertical line on the left. Roles stack vertically with generous padding. Minimalist nodes.
experience_timeline.content: Role, Company, Dates, 1-2 highlight bullets. Use `[PLACEHOLDER: Role]`, `[PLACEHOLDER: Company]`, etc.

skills.layout: Grouped categories. Typographic list rather than heavy cards. Overline for category name, comma-separated list of skills.
skills.content: Use `[PLACEHOLDER: Skill Category]` and `[PLACEHOLDER: Skills List]`.

projects_highlights.layout: Large editorial grid. Hover interactions (framer-motion image reveal on cursor or subtle color shift).
projects_highlights.content: Project name, role, impact. Use `[PLACEHOLDER: Project Name]`.

contact.layout: Massive typography for email. Minimalist footer layout.
contact.content: Email: `[PLACEHOLDER: email@example.com]`, Links: LinkedIn, GitHub (`[PLACEHOLDER: GitHub Link]`).

images.description: Executive portrait proxy for Peterson Pereira.
Subtle abstract architectural element for parallax backgrounds or chapter dividers.

component_instructions.Shadcn: Use Shadcn primarily for complex interactive elements (e.g., Dialogs). For layout sections, stick to raw HTML/Tailwind to maintain the custom editorial art direction.
component_instructions.Icons: Use `lucide-react`. Keep them small and minimal.
component_instructions.Placeholders: CRITICAL: Wrap any missing resume data in explicit placeholders like `[PLACEHOLDER: GitHub URL]` or `[PLACEHOLDER: Company Name]`.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: No centered layouts for body text; keep paragraphs left-aligned for an editorial feel.
Do NOT use pure #000000 or #FFFFFF. Use the provided tinted slate/navy and off-white hex codes.
Ensure all interactive elements and key text containers have a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid='hero-heading'`).
Use Framer Motion extensively for staggered reveals and line-by-line masked text animations on load.
Add generous padding (p-12, p-24) to let the typography breathe.
Never apply `transition-all`. Target specific properties like `transition-colors`, `transition-transform`.
